adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the DB is updated first via prisma.booking.update(... attendees.createMany ...), then the external sync is attempted with `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` outside any transaction/try-catch. If the calendar provider call throws, the mutation will fail after guests are already persisted, leaving internal attendees updated but the external calendar unchanged, with no rollback/compensating action shown in the diff.
